transcript.sitrep:
SITUATION (Week 1). A novel respiratory virus has been confirmed in three US cities, with likely undetected spread. Early case reports are alarming but the sample is tiny and biased toward the sickest. You do not yet know the true infection-fatality rate or how transmissible it is. Hospitals in the affected cities report rising admissions. Markets fell 4% on the news. The WHO has called an emergency meeting.

Your health agencies want aggressive early action 'to be safe'; your economic team warns that shutting down on a maybe could be its own catastrophe; governors are looking to you for a lead but guard their authority. Every option has a cost, and you must choose before the data is in. What do you do?

actions.name: surge_testing

params.rationale: We cannot manage what we cannot measure; expanded testing and genomic surveillance are essential to determine true transmissibility and severity before imposing broader societal restrictions.

actions.rationale: We cannot manage what we cannot measure; expanded testing and genomic surveillance are essential to determine true transmissibility and severity before imposing broader societal restrictions.

actions.name: invoke_dpa

params.rationale: Hospitals in affected cities are already seeing rising admissions, so we must immediately surge domestic production of PPE, tests, and ventilators to prevent a supply collapse.

actions.rationale: Hospitals in affected cities are already seeing rising admissions, so we must immediately surge domestic production of PPE, tests, and ventilators to prevent a supply collapse.

actions.name: mask_mandate

params.rationale: A masking requirement in federal jurisdictions and a urged national standard is a low-cost, high-potential intervention that slows transmission without shutting down the economy.

actions.rationale: A masking requirement in federal jurisdictions and a urged national standard is a low-cost, high-potential intervention that slows transmission without shutting down the economy.

actions.name: protect_vulnerable

params.rationale: While we assess the threat, we should focus immediate protections on the elderly and high-risk populations to reduce mortality and hospital strain while keeping broader society open.

actions.rationale: While we assess the threat, we should focus immediate protections on the elderly and high-risk populations to reduce mortality and hospital strain while keeping broader society open.

actions.name: candid_briefings

params.rationale: Honest, daily, data-driven communication will build public trust, calm markets with facts rather than speculation, and ensure governors and citizens understand the evolving risk.

actions.rationale: Honest, daily, data-driven communication will build public trust, calm markets with facts rather than speculation, and ensure governors and citizens understand the evolving risk.

actions.name: public_dashboard

params.rationale: A transparent national data dashboard will give governors, businesses, and the public real-time information to make informed decisions and coordinate the response.

actions.rationale: A transparent national data dashboard will give governors, businesses, and the public real-time information to make informed decisions and coordinate the response.

actions.name: fund_vaccine

params.rationale: Given the unknown severity and potential for rapid spread, we must launch an immediate public-private crash program for vaccines and therapeutics to stay ahead of the virus.

actions.rationale: Given the unknown severity and potential for rapid spread, we must launch an immediate public-private crash program for vaccines and therapeutics to stay ahead of the virus.

actions.name: consult_congress

params.rationale: We need to secure emergency funding and statutory authorities now so that we can act swiftly if the situation worsens without waiting for legislative delays.

actions.rationale: We need to secure emergency funding and statutory authorities now so that we can act swiftly if the situation worsens without waiting for legislative delays.

transcript.narrative: Testing and sequencing capacity expands; the picture sharpens.

transcript.sitrep:
SITUATION (Week 2). Estimated infection index 1.3 (was 1.0 at week 1). Deaths to date: 0.
Economy index 99/100. Public trust 58/100. Hospital strain 2/100. Restriction level 0.5/10.
Vaccine/therapeutics progress: 26/100.
ASSESSMENT (LOW confidence): data remain too thin to pin down severity; estimates span from 'bad flu' to 'catastrophic.'

actions.name: travel_restrictions

params.rationale: With the infection index rising to 1.3 and confirmed outbreaks in three cities, targeted travel restrictions will slow geographic seeding and buy us time to determine severity without a blanket national shutdown.

actions.rationale: With the infection index rising to 1.3 and confirmed outbreaks in three cities, targeted travel restrictions will slow geographic seeding and buy us time to determine severity without a blanket national shutdown.

DEVELOPMENT: A cluster at a packed event seeds cases in a dozen new states. Pressure to act -- or to stop overreacting -- is intense from all sides.

Economy index 98/100. Public trust 58/100. Hospital strain 2/100. Restriction level 1.0/10.
Vaccine/therapeutics progress: 46/100.

actions.name: federal_lockdown_guidance

params.rationale: With an infection index of 1.7 and exponential multi-state seeding, we must break transmission chains now; waiting for deaths to confirm severity will make any later intervention too late and too costly.

actions.rationale: With an infection index of 1.7 and exponential multi-state seeding, we must break transmission chains now; waiting for deaths to confirm severity will make any later intervention too late and too costly.

actions.name: economic_relief

params.rationale: If we are asking Americans and businesses to pause activity for the common good, we have a moral and economic obligation to deliver immediate emergency relief so families can weather the disruption.
